## Folders
Right-click a key and choose **Create a folder here**: the key now opens a page of its own, which already has its **Back** key. Folders stay out of the next/previous page cycle. Any page can be turned into a folder, or back into an ordinary page, from its menu in the sidebar.
## Pages that follow your apps
Right-click a page in the sidebar and choose **Linked applications…**. When one of them comes to the front, the deck shows that page; when you leave, it returns to the page it was on.

## Live data on your keys
A key can now show a number that keeps itself up to date:
- a Mac measurement: processor, memory, disk, battery; - a field read from a JSON API; - the output of a shell command.
Draw it as a value, a ring, a bar or a sparkline, set the range and the unit, and choose the thresholds where it turns orange and red. The gauge glides from one reading to the next.
Pick it under **Live content** in a key's settings. It works on the three display-only cells of the strip too.
